About

Personal service, professional standards

I'm Julie Altieri, an Authorized Court Transcriptionist serving law firms, legal professionals, courts, and individuals across Ontario.

Every order is handled with care for accuracy, confidentiality, and your deadline. Ordering is straightforward: clear communication, transparent pricing, and a certified transcript prepared to the standards of Ontario's Ministry of the Attorney General.

I accept direct orders, and for larger matters I also work alongside other authorized transcriptionists and established transcript providers when extra capacity is needed — so bigger proceedings still meet their deadlines.

Pricing

Certified transcripts, mandated rates

I prepare certified transcripts of Ontario court proceedings only — from the Ontario Court of Justice and the Superior Court of Justice. Certified transcripts are delivered electronically by email.

TurnaroundDelivery timeRate (CAD)
Standard1–4 weeks$6.30 / page
Expedited5 business days$8.80 / page
Daily24 hours$11.75 / page

Rates are for electronic certified transcripts, mandated under Ontario Regulation 145/22, amending Ontario Regulation 94/14 under the Administration of Justice Act, for orders placed on or after 1 April 2022. Totals are in CAD, plus applicable taxes and fees. As a guide, one hour of court proceedings generally produces 30–40 pages. Anything not listed here will be confirmed in your written quote before work begins.

FAQ

Questions, answered

Ordering

How do I order a transcript?

Three ways: use the online order form on this page and I'll prepare the official form for you; download the official Ontario Court Transcript Order Form, fill it in and email it to julie@altieritranscripts.ca; or order through WhatsApp using the prepared checklist. In every case, I'll confirm the details and send a written quote before work begins.

What details do I need to provide?

Your contact information, the case name (for example, R. v. Smith), the court file number, the courthouse location, the date(s) in court, the type of matter and proceeding, the courtroom number and judge if known, and the court level — Ontario Court of Justice or Superior Court of Justice. The online form on this page walks you through each item, with drop-downs for the standard choices.

Can you handle a large or multi-day matter?

Yes. I accept direct orders, and when extra capacity is needed for larger matters I work with other authorized transcriptionists and established transcript providers. Your written quote will confirm the arrangement and timeline.

Pricing & Estimates

How much does a transcript cost?

Electronic certified transcripts are charged at mandated per-page rates: Standard $6.30 per page, Expedited $8.80 per page, and Daily $11.75 per page, in CAD plus applicable taxes and fees. Use the Quick Estimate above for a ballpark figure.

How many pages will my proceeding be?

As a guide, one hour of court proceedings generally produces 30–40 pages. The final page count depends on the actual proceeding, and your written quote will confirm the total before transcription begins.

Where do these rates come from?

The rates are mandated under Ontario Regulation 145/22, amending Ontario Regulation 94/14 under the Administration of Justice Act, for orders placed on or after 1 April 2022.

Turnaround

How fast can I get my transcript?

Standard turnaround is 1–4 weeks, Expedited is 5 business days, and Daily is 24 hours. Choose the turnaround that matches your deadline when you order, and I'll confirm it in your written quote.

Delivery & Format

How is my transcript delivered?

Certified transcripts are delivered electronically by email at the rates shown on this page.

Can I order only part of a proceeding?

Yes — you can request an excerpt rather than the full proceeding. Choose “Excerpt only” in the drop-down on the order form and note the portion you need, and your written quote will confirm the details.

Certification & Accuracy

Are the transcripts certified?

Yes. I'm an Authorized Court Transcriptionist, and transcripts are prepared and certified following the standards of Ontario's Ministry of the Attorney General. You can verify my authorization in the official registry, linked in the About section above.

Which courts do you cover?

I prepare certified transcripts of Ontario court proceedings from the Ontario Court of Justice and the Superior Court of Justice, for law firms, legal professionals, courts, and individuals across Ontario.
